Kia India to invest $2B in second plant in Andhra Pradesh
Spread across a combined 465 acres for Kia and its suppliers, the new facility is expected to generate around 12,000 direct and indirect job opportunities.
Kia India has committed a combined investment of $2 billion, along with its supplier partners, to set up its second manufacturing facility in Andhra Pradesh.
The carmaker signed a memorandum of understanding with the state government to formalise the plan.
The factory will be located in Anantapur, the same district that houses Kia's current plant. It will add 2 lakh units of annual manufacturing capacity, taking Kia India’s combined capacity across both plants to over 6 lakh units a year.
Kia India is targeting early 2030 for production to begin, with the plant carrying out stamping, welding, painting and assembly. This plant will manufacture new models across ICE and EV powertrains, the company said in a statement.
Kia and its suppliers will together occupy 465 acres on the new site. The company expects the facility to support roughly 12,000 jobs, both direct and indirect.
In comparison, the first plant, across 945 acres, employs 24,237 people through direct and indirect roles. Set up with an initial investment of $2.9 billion, the facility builds the Seltos, Syros, Sonet, Carens, Carens Clavis, Carnival and Sorento models, spanning ICE, EV, CNG and hybrid versions.

articles.title: Rethinking Memory For AI Inference
articles.summary:
Processing data closer to memory could reduce power and boost performance, but software, thermal, and architectural challenges remain.
Key Takeaways:
The shift from AI training in data centers to AI inferencing at the edge will require a fundamental rethinking of where and how data is processed and stored, how it is prioritized, and what needs to be traded off in terms of power and performance to stay within a limited power budget.
At the center of these efforts is a recognition that the explosion of data — especially in physical AI where data is being live-streamed from sensors — requires much of that data to be processed as close to memory as possible. This has been a topic of discussion since the inception of the Internet of Things, but it really began gaining traction with AI due to the flood of data and concerns about the amount of power required to move and process it. In battery-electric vehicles and drones, for example, the less energy spent on processing data, the greater the range per charge and the more energy that can be allocated to critical and not-so-critical functions.
The challenge is understanding what data needs to be kept, what can be discarded, and what needs to be acted upon. Those are very different priorities. Making those choices requires advanced processing, and the quickest path to results using the least amount of energy is to minimize the distance data needs to travel between processing and memory.

articles.title: La Unión Europea propuso que los usuarios puedan apagar el desplazamiento infinito y la reproducción automática

La Comisión Europea presentó el 11 de noviembre la Ley de Equidad Digital, una propuesta que obligaría a redes sociales, plataformas de video y videojuegos a ofrecer una herramienta para apagar las funciones pensadas para enganchar: el desplazamiento infinito, la reproducción automática y las notificaciones sin relación con la actividad del usuario.
El texto, que todavía debe pasar por el Parlamento Europeo y el Consejo de la Unión Europea, reemplazaría la directiva de 2005 sobre prácticas comerciales desleales por un reglamento de aplicación directa. Según The Next Web, eso sustituiría 27 regímenes nacionales por una sola norma, válida para cualquier empresa que venda a consumidores europeos, esté donde esté.
El artículo sobre diseño adictivo enumera cuatro funciones que el usuario podrá desactivar, una por una o todas juntas: la reproducción automática sin pausas efectivas, las notificaciones ajenas a su actividad, los premios o castigos según la frecuencia de uso y los mensajes insistentes con que un chatbot simula una relación personal.
La obligación es ofrecer el interruptor, no prohibir esas funciones. Itxaso Domínguez de Olazábal, asesora de políticas de la organización de derechos digitales EDRi, cuestionó ese punto ante EUobserver: “¿Por qué reconocer tan explícitamente el problema del diseño adictivo sin introducir obligaciones más fuertes para prevenirlo?”.

articles.title: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said on Thursday, according to reports from Bloomberg and NBC News.
Huang, who stepped down as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.
Huang has agreed to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving, which falls later this month.
The development comes after House Republicans Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford sent Huang a letter on November 4 requesting that he appear before their committees. Moolenaar chairs the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, Mast chairs the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, and Crawford chairs the House Intelligence Committee.
“Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.”
The testimony will take place behind closed doors, though Mast said he expects the briefing to be recorded on video and transcribed.

articles.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing 3.8 Flash

Google is continuing its elemental AI naming scheme with the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen. These names are less descriptive than the Pro/Flash monikers of earlier releases, but Hydrogen’s purpose is clear: It replaces the faster, more economical Flash models most people in Google’s ecosystem use.
With Google’s recent Argon and Carbon releases, the rollout was staged and began with cybersecurity researchers. Even when general availability began, Google restricted access to users paying for its most expensive AI subscription. The limits for Hydrogen are much more relaxed, with access beginning immediately. This model has replaced Gemini 3.8 Flash across the company’s products.
Google claims that Hydrogen represents a major improvement versus the previous Flash model. It runs in one of four thinking levels (low, medium, high, and the new xhigh), and even in high mode, it’s 2.5 times faster than Flash 3.8. Plus, it reduces “fabricated claims” by more than 5x, according to Google’s analysis. Users will also see gains in code generation, with Hydrogen more than tripling 3.8 Flash’s score in Terminal-Bench. In some cases, Hydrogen even trades blows with Argon. It managed a score of 54 in the popular Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with xhigh mode versus 50 for Argon.

articles.title: From prototype to production: Engineering agents with Agent DLC | Amazon Web Services
articles.summary:
Artificial Intelligence
From prototype to production: Engineering agents with Agent DLC
Over the past year, AI agents have moved from exploration into engineering. Enterprise teams are shipping large language model (LLM) systems that call tools, orchestrate APIs, and answer questions over internal knowledge.
A successful demo can show what an agent is capable of. Before release, the team needs to answer a further question: “Is this agent ready for production?” The person responsible for that decision needs evidence that the agent meets the agreed requirements.
To make that decision consistently, teams need a repeatable, affordable way to assess the agent’s current behavior and whether the latest change has improved it.
In traditional software development, teams answer these questions with unit tests, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and passing builds. Those mechanisms are necessary but not sufficient for agents, for three reasons, each requiring additional checks. This post explains these three properties and presents a measured case where an aggregate metric hides a coverage problem. It then introduces the Agent Development Lifecycle (Agent DLC): one lifecycle, two loops, and a single explicit standard for judging every change.

Getting a vaccine to a child starts long before anyone loads a cold box. It starts with knowing the child’s community exists.
About 2.1 million Nigerian children, representing 24% of the country’s estimated 8.7 million under-one population, had not received a single routine vaccine dose, according to the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF). The 2023 estimate made Nigeria the country with the highest number of zero-dose children globally.
Some live in remote settlements cut off from health facilities by difficult terrain and long distances. Others live in conflict-affected communities or settlements missing from the maps and population estimates used to plan campaigns. Without reliable information about where people live and how to reach them, health authorities risk excluding them from vaccination campaigns.
For more than a decade, eHealth Africa, a non-profit developing data-driven solutions for health systems, has supported Nigeria’s immunisation programmes through geospatial settlement mapping, digital campaign planning with PlanFeld and vaccine delivery tracking. In the first half of 2026 alone, vaccination campaigns supported by the organisation reached more than 23 million children across over 205,000 settlements in Nigeria, according to its 2026 Mid-Year Report. But these tools will only endure if Nigerian institutions can fund, operate and maintain them.

Sin embargo, esto solo será posible si tenemos un motivo que entre dentro de los supuestos recogidos en el artículo 7.2 de esta legislación. No basta con que el perro vaya sin bozal. Es preciso que exista un motivo que entre dentro de estos supuestos. Que el perro vaya sin bozal por el portal o ascensor y lo vea algún otro residente no implica que exista una de estas actividades prohibidas. Es preciso conocer qué es lo que realmente ocurre y cuál es la obligación que se aplica y si es incumplida.

articles.title: Technical Debt is Social; it is the Price of Learning by Doing
articles.summary:
Technical debt is not necessarily a sign of poor engineering. It can be the price of learning through software in use. As AI accelerates code production beyond our capacity to understand code and context, technical debt increasingly becomes a sociotechnical challenge, Xin Yao noted in her talk "What If Your Biggest Technical Debt Is Social", at GOTO Copenhagen.
Yao quoted Ward Cunningham, who defined debt as "not-quite-right code". Debt sounds like a negative thing, but it can be a deliberate business strategy, she explained:
If we release the code now, well knowing it’s not perfect for the future yet, we’ll get some business feedback, we’ll get some user feedback, we’ll probably get paid for something, and that’s good as a business strategy.
Debt isn’t about poorly written code; it arises when we design software with incomplete knowledge. Hence, debt is the price of learning by doing, Yao argued. Releasing software allows us to test our assumptions against reality. Once we’ve got a learning experience, we have to put that experience back into our code and pay off the debt, she added. The debt becomes problematic when our software doesn’t catch up with our new learning.
Debt can be a good communication strategy toward management. It provides an economic argument for the cost of postponing architectural improvements. La norma alcanza a todas las áreas del instituto y a los proveedores que trabajan con sus datos. Esta acción provoca que ninguna decisión sobre tratamientos o medicamentos podrá quedar solo en manos de un sistema automático.
El manual dispone que cualquier desarrollo con IA pase por una evaluación formal antes de ponerse en marcha. También regula el uso individual de asistentes de IA por parte de los trabajadores, que solo podrán emplear plataformas habilitadas por el organismo.
Los empleados tampoco podrán cargar información sensible en servicios que no ofrezcan garantías de confidencialidad. Los datos personales de los afiliados deberán anonimizarse siempre que sea posible, y cada uso necesitará el aval de las áreas de protección de datos y de asuntos jurídicos.
PAMI es la obra social que atiende a adultos mayores en Argentina. Sus afiliados dependen de ella para acceder a tratamientos, medicamentos y otras prestaciones, y esos son los casos que la norma protege con control humano.
Un comité de ética evaluará cada proyecto
Para revisar las propuestas, el instituto creó un Comité de Ética de Inteligencia Artificial. Lo integran especialistas técnicos, legales, médicos y de seguridad informática, y su funcionamiento se rige por un reglamento específico.

articles.title: Tempolimit auf der Autobahn: Warum Deutschland weltweit allein dasteht
articles.summary:
Weg frei für ein Tempolimit? Was 120 km/h für Klima und Geldbeutel bedeuten
Auf fast drei Vierteln der deutschen Autobahnen gibt es kein Tempolimit. Das ist weltweit einzigartig. Dabei machen Autobahnen nur knapp 1,5 Prozent des deutschen Straßennetzes aus. Trotzdem ist der Verkehr auf Autobahnen für mehr als 40 Prozent der CO2-Emissionen von Pkw in Deutschland verantwortlich. Gründe sind die intensive Nutzung der Autobahnen sowie die hohen Durchschnittsgeschwindigkeiten.
Als deutsche Politiker 1971 begannen, erstmals ernsthaft über ein Tempolimit auf Autobahnen nachzudenken, hatten andere europäische Länder solche Regelungen längst eingeführt. Der oft bizarre Streit überlebte in den vergangenen 55 Jahren Öl- und Wirtschaftskrisen, Regierungswechsel und Klimaschutzdebatten. Ein Ende ist nicht abzusehen. Zwei neue Studien bringen wieder Schwung in die Debatte.

articles.title: AI's infrastructure boom is standing on porcelain legs
articles.summary:
AI's infrastructure boom is standing on porcelain legs
Why AI agents are straining data infrastructure
AI may look seamless at the surface, but underneath, search and analytics are still pulling in different directions.
There is an image I keep returning to when I think about AI infrastructure – an elephant standing on porcelain legs. The systems being built above the data layer are getting heavier and more ambitious, while the foundations beneath them receive far less attention. Investors and technology companies talk about AI infrastructure constantly, but they usually mean chips, models, and the applications built on top of them.
But AI infrastructure is more than that. Every one of those applications depends on a less fashionable layer underneath – the systems that find, retrieve, and analyze its data.
Co-Founder and CEO of SereneDB.
In many businesses, search and analytics still live in separate systems. One finds relevant information in documents and other unstructured data. The other calculates, compares, and identifies patterns. Pipelines copy and synchronize information between them, while engineers keep the systems working together.
Separating search from analytics was not a foolish design choice. The split became the status quo because it suited the questions, hardware, and users of the time. Now, however, natural-language interfaces and AI agents are exposing the cracks.

Build composable, interoperable multi-agent systems with A2A on AWS
Agents in multi-agent systems that span organizational boundaries often need to collaborate in a composable, interoperable way, with agents that other organizations build and run. They need a way to discover each other, communicate, and exchange tasks without exposing internals or requiring the same framework on both sides.
The Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol addresses this constraint. Without A2A, building composable multi-agent systems across organizational boundaries requires custom integration code for each customer and framework. Independent software vendors (ISVs) can instead build composable, interoperable agents that work with the A2A-compatible frameworks their customers already use.
While we frame this post around the ISV use case, the pattern also applies to organizations that expose agents across boundaries, whether to partners, customers, or internal teams that use different frameworks. As your system grows, you add skills by registering Agent Cards with the orchestrator, without changing the agents already running.
In this post, we walk through a deployed reference architecture on AWS. A LangChain-based enterprise orchestrator communicates with a Strands Agents-based software as a service (SaaS) agent across organizational boundaries using A2A, with the enterprise and the SaaS provider in separate AWS accounts. La compañía precisó que, en la gran mayoría de los espacios afectados, las transcripciones son “no atribuibles”: no indican quién escribió el mensaje ni a qué espacio pertenece. Tampoco contienen los resultados de las herramientas que el asistente consulta. Notion aclaró que no hay otra información que vincule cada chat con usuarios o empresas, más allá del texto de la conversación.

articles.title: Ars Live: What drone attacks on data centers mean for modern life in the cloud
articles.summary:
Drone and missile strikes have inflicted unprecedented damage on data centers in Eastern Europe and the Middle East this year, disrupting cloud services for millions of people and permanently deleting some Amazon Web Services customer data. This trend represents a new concern for Big Tech companies—but also for governments and everyone else who depends on common digital services in modern life.
To explore what this all means for modern society’s reliance on cloud resilience, I will be hosting a live conversation titled “Drone attacks and data centers: New Risks for Big Tech” on Tuesday, November 17 at 1 pm ET with Joseph Jarnecki, a senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI), a UK defense and security think tank. He leads RUSI’s work on how cloud services factor into national security and defense, along with tech sovereignty efforts.
Jarnecki has done extensive research on how Ukraine strengthened its cloud resilience with Western partners despite facing both cyberattacks and kinetic attacks at the start of the full-scale Russian invasion, and explored what that means for NATO and European governments’ cloud adoption plans.
This year, Jarnecki has written about Iran’s drone and missile strikes on Amazon data centers in the Middle East during the US-Israeli war with Iran, and the broader implications for governments and Big Tech. He has also commented on the impacts of Russia and Ukraine exchanging strikes on each other’s data centers.

The storage maker warned that the flaws could be abused to remotely access and attack vulnerable devices, giving cyber-criminals – or rogue AI agents, for that matter – an easy avenue to wreak havoc on users' data and local IT infrastructure.

articles.title: Outlook en panne : des milliers d’utilisateurs privés de leurs mails ce jeudi soir — Frandroid

Sur notre smartphone, l’application Outlook affiche un triangle bleu, deux petits plots de chantier gris et une phrase laconique : « Erreur lors du chargement du message ».
On n’est visiblement pas seuls à contempler cette illustration. Sur Downdetector, le site qui agrège les signalements d’internautes, la courbe d’Outlook s’est envolée en fin de journée.
En France, la plateforme comptait 402 signalements peu après 19 heures, soit son pic sur les dernières 24 heures. Le phénomène est bien plus massif outre-Atlantique, où les signalements ont commencé à grimper vers midi, heure de New York (18 heures à Paris).
Les symptômes se ressemblent : application qui ne charge plus, Outlook sur le Web qui reste blanc, boîte affichée comme « déconnectée » sans envoi ni réception.
Microsoft n’a encore rien confirmé
Au début de la panne, la page de statut officielle de Microsoft n’affichait aucun incident. Rien d’inhabituel : l’entreprise met souvent un moment à reconnaître un problème, et le détaille d’abord aux administrateurs informatiques dans le centre d’administration de Microsoft 365.
Aucune cause n’est connue à ce stade. Le service en cause pourrait être Exchange Online, le serveur de messagerie en ligne de Microsoft qui fait tourner Outlook.com et les boîtes mail professionnelles. Quand il flanche, l’application n’est plus qu’une coquille vide, quel que soit l’appareil utilisé.

Note that gifts are sent immediately, so plan accordingly for when you want the recipient to get it.

articles.title: Nigeria’s Raenest acquires UK-based payments company Remitise - Disrupt Africa
articles.summary:
Nigerian fintech startup Raenest has completed the acquisition of Remitise, a UK-based payments company, for an undisclosed amount to expand its regulatory footprint and gain greater control over its global payments infrastructure.
Founded in 2022 by Victor Alade, Sodruldeen Mustapha, and Richard Oyome, Raenest initially operated as an Employer of Record (EOR) before evolving into a platform that redefines global banking for Africans, helping businesses and freelancers receive international payments, convert between currencies, operate a multi-currency wallet, while managing transactions seamlessly.
The platform also enables customers to open global bank accounts in their names, access physical and virtual dollar cards, and manage payments in USD, EUR, and GBP. To date, the company has amassed over one million individual customers across more than 50 countries, processed over US$2 billion in payments, and served over 300 businesses. Le portage était presque terminé quand l’équipe a dû l’abandonner. Avec le MTE désormais disponible, il pourra sortir.
Pixel 11 : un portage quasi prêt, derrière QPR2 et le Signature 27
Nous rapportions le 31 août que l’équipe de GrapheneOS renonçait au Pixel 11. Elle déconseillait même de l’acheter. Le projet était pourtant bien avancé. D’après son message sur X, le portage était presque fini environ une semaine après la sortie des téléphones. Le blocage venait du MTE (Memory Tagging Extension), absent de ces modèles.
Le principe est simple. Chaque zone de mémoire reçoit une étiquette. Si un programme tente d’accéder à une zone qui n’est pas la sienne, les étiquettes ne correspondent plus et le processeur bloque l’accès. GrapheneOS estime que cela neutralise presque tous les exploits à distance. Les Pixel disposent de cette protection depuis le Pixel 8, et Graphene OS avait pour habitude de l’activer sur tout le système, y compris pour la plupart des applications, même sans l’accord de leurs développeurs. De son côté, Google ne l’a jamais activé par défaut sur Android.

Il s’agit d’une faille qui a été exploitée par des pirates avant que Google ne puisse réagir et lancer un correctif.
Dans son bulletin de sécurité, Google indique avoir pris « connaissance de l’existence » d’une tactique d’exploitation qui permet de lancer des attaques « dans la nature ». En clair, des cybercriminels se servent déjà de cette brèche pour attaquer des internautes.
À lire aussi : Ces 319 extensions Chrome ont espionné des millions d’internautes pendant 10 ans
Une faille dans la mémoire de Chrome
La vulnérabilité se situe dans le composant de Chrome chargé de lire le XML, le format de fichier texte qui sert à ranger et échanger des informations entre logiciels. Google précise qu’il s’agit d’une faille de type « use after free », une erreur de gestion de la mémoire très fréquente dans les navigateurs. Concrètement, Chrome libère une zone de la mémoire, mais continue ensuite de s’en servir. Un attaquant peut alors en profiter pour glisser ses propres données dans la mémoire.
Pour exploiter cette faille, les pirates doivent mettre au point une page web piégée, taillée pour déclencher la cyberattaque sans que l’internaute ne se rende compte de rien. Google a jugé la faille de sévérité « élevée ». Comme d’habitude, Google ne donne pas beaucoup de détails sur les cyberat…

What happens when powerful technology enters any organization where sensitive information is used to support decisions that may later need to be explained and defended?
The answer is not to keep AI out of investigations, intelligence or other high-stakes work, but to deploy it in ways that can withstand scrutiny. Within secure, auditable systems, with clear boundaries and human oversight, AI tools can help organizations connect information, manage growing caseloads and identify important patterns while ensuring that every insight can be traced, explained and defended.

Thursday, November 12th 2026
Apex Neural Rendering Beats NVIDIA DLSS in Both Image Quality and Performance
According to a company called Apex Compute, there is a new player in neural rendering. The company has developed Apex Neural Rendering, which reportedly offers higher quality and performance than NVIDIA's DLSS implementations. It includes three key components: frame generation (ANR FG), super resolution upscaling (ANR SR), and ray reconstruction denoising for ray tracing (ANR RR). Running frame generation on NVIDIA's GeForce RTX 5090 at 4K, the ANR FG achieves a latency of 1.01 ms per generated frame at a 2x setting, while NVIDIA's DLSS Frame Generation records 1.26 ms. We are not sure which version of DLSS FG was tested, but we can assume it was the latest version.
Regarding memory consumption, ANR FG uses only 214 MB of GPU memory, while DLSS FG requires more than double that, at 562 MB. Reportedly, the ANR FG neural network weights fit within just 0.17 MB, which is incredibly efficient. Based on samples on the company's website, the image quality that ANR delivers matches DLSS and even surpasses it in some cases. Apex Compute also managed to get Hogwarts Legacy and The Last of Us Part II Remastered working, showing the difference compared to DLSS, resulting in frame generation with more visual fidelity. articles.summary:
THE AFTERMATH: Jensen Huang's resignation this morning ends Nvidia's 33-year founder era, but it doesn't end the story. There's a search for a successor with no obvious candidate, an espionage case now touching four governments, a congressional hearing, and a growing roster of people offering their own picks for who should run the world's most important AI chipmaker.
Nvidia moved quickly to project continuity. In an internal memo, longtime director Harvey Jones told employees he would serve as the company's first-ever board chair. Jones, a former Synopsys CEO, has sat on Nvidia's board since its founding in 1993. The fact that Nvidia never had a separate chair until today says a lot about how much authority sat with one person.
CFO Colette Kress, at Nvidia since 2013, will run the company on an interim basis while keeping her finance role. Artificial Intelligence
Optimizing cost per task and proving agent ROI on Amazon Bedrock
Part 1 of this series built the operating model that controls Amazon Bedrock spend: attribution with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) principal tags and Cost and Usage Report 2.0, observability with model invocation logging, enforcement at three tiers, and a review cadence. That layer answers who spent it, and you can stop them. It can’t tell you whether the spend was well spent.
This post answers two questions that Part 1 deliberately left open. First: Why is this workflow expensive? The answer requires thinking in cost per task, not cost per token. Second: Is the agent better than the humans were? The answer requires baselines, controlled experiments, and a scorecard tied to decisions.
In this post, you learn a framework for calculating true model cost (including four hidden cost drivers that the pricing page doesn’t show), techniques for reducing cost per task through caching, routing, and output constraints, and a discipline for measuring agent ROI with human baselines, holdout experiments, and a five-dimension scorecard. This post is written for two audiences: the application and platform engineers who own the optimization levers, and the product owners and FinOps partners who need to justify agent spend to leadership.

El tema volvió a la agenda el 11 de noviembre, cuando la Comisión Europea propuso la Ley de Equidad Digital. El texto busca que los contratos y suscripciones digitales sean más fáciles de cancelar y que terminen las renovaciones automáticas no deseadas y las pruebas gratuitas que se convierten en trampas de cobro.
Según la Comisión, alrededor del 60% de los europeos compra bienes o servicios en línea, y quienes lo hacen tienen más de 60% más probabilidades de sufrir problemas que quienes compran en tiendas físicas. La propuesta todavía no es ley, de modo que la protección depende por ahora de cada usuario.
Primero, averiguar quién cobra
Antes de buscar el botón de baja conviene saber quién emite el cargo. Apple recomienda buscar en el correo las palabras “receipt from Apple” o “invoice from Apple” (recibo de Apple). Si el recibo no aparece, la suscripción pudo contratarse con otra empresa, y el resumen del banco o de la tarjeta indica cuál.

Klein, unsichtbar und ungewöhnlich massereich
Doch der Begleiter des Roten Riesen gibt den Forschenden Rätsel auf. Er ist sehr klein und außergewöhnlich massereich.
Das mysteriöse Objekt ist außerdem unsichtbar. Es lässt sich also nicht direkt optisch wahrnehmen, sondern nur durch die Auswirkungen seiner Schwerkraft auf die Umlaufbahn des Roten Riesen.
Ist das unsichtbare Objekt ein Neutronenstern?
Um welche Art von Himmelskörper handelt es sich bei dem seltsamen Begleiter? Die Autor:innen der Studie, die in der Zeitschrift Science Advances erschienen ist, tippten zunächst auf einen Neutronenstern.
Da Neutronensterne sehr klein sind, ist ihr Licht mit gängigen Instrumenten meist nicht messbar. Diese extrem dichten Objekte entstehen, wenn ein massiver Stern als Supernova explodiert.
Neutronensterne besitzen typischerweise eine Sonnenmasse von 1,4. Sie sind also 1,4 Mal so massereich wie unsere Sonne.

Kress said, “Nvidia’s strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years.”
Kress will retain the finance role while serving as interim CEO. She joined Nvidia in 2013 after nearly 25 years in finance roles at technology companies including Cisco and Microsoft.
The board appointed former Synopsys chief executive and executive chairman Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever chair.

UCIe Consortium Advances from Chiplet Connectivity to System-Level Integration with UCIe 4.0 Specification
Today, the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) Consortium, the open standards group for interconnects between chiplets within a package, announced the release of the UCIe 4.0 Specification, taking the UCIe architecture beyond chiplet-level interface design to address key requirements for integrating multiple chiplets into a cohesive on-package system.
As chiplet architecture grows more sophisticated, connectivity is only part of the challenge. Systems incorporating compute, accelerator, memory and other chiplets must also address how those components are managed, secured and monitored while efficiently using power, die area and package resources. The UCIe 4.0 Specification addresses these broader system-level requirements with new capabilities spanning manageability and security, efficiency, memory connectivity and reliability."UCIe is evolving from defining how individual chiplets connect to addressing what is required for multiple chiplets to function together as a system," said Cheolmin Park, UCIe Consortium President and Samsung Corporate VP and Head of Package Marketing team at Samsung Electro-Mechanics. articles.title: Harari Warns Tech Leaders Against Pursuing AI Superintelligence - EE Times
articles.summary:
BARCELONA, Spain — Addressing corporate technology executives at the Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo, historian and philosopher Yuval Noah Harari warned that the tech industry’s race to create artificial superintelligence is a historic market failure driven by ideological fantasy rather than economic rationality.
In an onstage conversation with John Thornhill, editor of The Financial Times, Harari argued that treating autonomous software as a mere tool fatally misjudges its nature.
Urging CIOs and policymakers to halt the pursuit of uncontrollable digital gods, he called for redirecting capital and research away from general superintelligence and toward narrow, verifiable systems that address tangible problems.
Emergence of the digital agents
When asked whether AI represents a rupture comparable to fire, the printing press, electricity, or computing, Harari pointed to agents: “AI is the first technology which is an agent,” he said. While the use of fire and nuclear power depends on human intent, artificial intelligence acts independently. “It’s your decision whether to use fire to cook your meal or to burn a forest. It’s not a fire’s decision. AI is different because it can make decisions on its own. It can invent new ideas on its own. It can invent the next technology on its own. The printing press could not invent the radio. AI can invent better AI.”
Viewing AI systems as tools is an error: “It’s better to think about them as animals, or creatures, or aliens to really understand. …

Le droit européen ne permet pas d’exiger de garder son vieux compteur électrique. Dans un arrêt rendu le 5 novembre, la Cour de justice de l’Union européenne (CJUE) estime qu’un gestionnaire de réseau « n’est pas tenu de se ranger au souhait d’un client final » qui ne veut pas d’un compteur intelligent. La directive européenne de 2019 sur le marché de l’électricité encourage fortement le déploiement de ces compteurs et donne aux consommateurs le droit d’en demander un, mais pas celui de conserver en toutes circonstances un modèle classique.
Dans une affaire autrichienne, une cliente refusait que le gestionnaire de réseau local remplace son compteur mécanique par un modèle numérique. Elle invoquait la protection de ses données et les ondes électromagnétiques, alors que l’étalonnage de son ancien appareil avait expiré fin 2023. Saisie par le tribunal régional de Sankt Pölten, la CJUE ne tranche pas le litige elle-même, qui reviendra à la justice autrichienne. En revanche, son interprétation du droit européen s’impose aux juridictions de tous les États membres, France comprise.
En France, l’arrêt confirme une obligation déjà en place
Pour les foyers français, la décision change peu de choses en pratique. En effet, le Code de l’énergie confie déjà aux gestionnaires de réseau la pose et le renouvellement des compteurs, et le médiateur national de l’énergie rappelle que les consommateurs ne peuvent pas s’opposer au remplacement. Microsoft corrigió una vulnerabilidad de Outlook que atacantes ya estaban explotando para obtener datos con los que suplantar a un usuario. El arreglo forma parte de su actualización mensual de seguridad, que según BleepingComputer corrige 1.235 fallas en total.
La falla se identifica como CVE-2026-124194. La empresa la describe como un fallo de suplantación: un atacante envía un archivo de mensaje manipulado y convence a la víctima de abrirlo. Al hacerlo, Outlook se conecta a una ubicación de red controlada por el atacante sin mostrar el aviso habitual de contenido externo.
Esa conexión puede revelar el hash NTLMv2 del usuario, según el aviso de Microsoft que citan SecurityWeek y The Hacker News, medios especializados en ciberseguridad y tecnología. Un hash es un código derivado de la contraseña de Windows: el atacante puede intentar descifrarlo para recuperar la clave o usarlo para iniciar sesión como la víctima en otros sistemas.
Microsoft precisó que el ataque requiere conexión de red y que la víctima abra el archivo. SecurityWeek agregó que la falla no se activa desde el panel de vista previa y que Microsoft la calificó como de gravedad moderada, con 6,5 puntos sobre 10.

articles.title: Connecting AI to the Physical World - EE Times
articles.summary:
Artificial intelligence is advancing rapidly. Models are becoming more capable, computing platforms more powerful, and tools for building intelligent applications more accessible. As AI moves into robots, industrial machines, vehicles, and drones, however, its progress depends on a practical question: How effectively can these systems obtain information from the physical world?
An intelligent machine needs more than processing power; it needs relevant data about its surroundings, the state of other machines, and the conditions in which it operates. Some information comes from its own sensors.
Other information must arrive from nearby devices, infrastructure, remote systems, or shared computing resources. The usefulness of that information depends on its quality, timing, and availability.
This creates an important opportunity for wireless technology. AI can make use only of information that devices can capture, process, and deliver. When the connection is unreliable, inflexible, or unsuitable for the environment, valuable information may arrive too late, lose essential context, or never reach the systems that need it.
The next stage of physical AI therefore requires progress in the devices and communications systems that connect intelligence to its surroundings. Software-defined radio (SDR) and the software intellectual property that makes it work have an important role to play.

articles.title: Más allá del debate sobre su éxito, el 11N deja una pregunta: para qué sirve realmente una huelga general en 2026
articles.summary:
El 11N ha sido una huelga especial por varias razones. Además de ser la primera gran convocatoria nacional en 14 años y llegar en plena campaña preelectoral, su detonante fue la crisis de la vivienda, un problema grave que sin embargo no está directamente relacionado con los derechos laborales. Dejando claro todo eso, el 11N también ofreció algunas imágenes previsibles que habíamos visto en huelgas anteriores: piquetes, manifestaciones, negocios cerrados y un encontronazo entre la patronal y los sindicatos a la hora de estimar el éxito de la convocatoria.
Más allá de todo eso, de las peculiaridades y el guion esperable del 11N, hay algunas preguntas que quedan botando: ¿Para qué sirven las huelgas en 2026? ¿Tienen el mismo impacto que en los años 90 u 80 o han perdido capacidad de presión? Y sobre todo, ¿cómo diablos medimos su alcance?
¿Cómo fue el 11N? La respuesta más rápida es ‘depende’. Depende de a quién le preguntes. Aunque en un principio hablaron de un seguimiento “dispar”, con un nivel de respaldo que oscilaba entre el 41 y 75% en función de la región, los sindicatos acabaron celebrando la jornada como “un éxito rotundo”.
La cosa cambia si consultamos a la CEOE. Para la patronal española fue un “fracaso” sin paliativos, una movilización que alcanzó un “mínimo histórico” con un apoyo de apenas el 5%. Por si no fuera suficiente, a ese baile de cifras se suman las que han ido desgranando las instituciones de uno y otro color.
En realidad, nada de eso resulta sorprenden…

Eso es un problema para los residentes, pero también para los trabajadores de temporada, muchos de ellos (ironía) dedicados al sector turístico.
Ahora en la isla está tomando forma un plan para atenderlos.
¿Qué ha pasado? Que Ibiza está buscando una solución para uno de sus grandes retos en materia habitacional: qué hacer con los miles de trabajadores que cada año llegan a la isla para cubrir empleos temporales, a menudo ligados a la hostelería y el sector turístico.
El Consell de Ibiza calcula que son alrededor de 30.000 personas, gente que habitualmente necesita buscar un techo para los meses de temporada alta y se encuentra, verano tras verano, con el mismo problema: un mercado residencial tensionado con precios intocables.

articles.title: Hyperspectral Imaging Lets Machines See Sick Plants First - EE Times
articles.summary:
Twelve days after planting soybean seeds in a greenhouse at North Dakota State University, researchers could distinguish plants affected by sudden-death syndrome from healthy plants using hyperspectral imaging. To the human eye, the plants still looked alike.
For Xin “Rex” Sun, director of the Peltier Institute for Advancement in Agricultural Technology at North Dakota State University, the experiment illustrates the promise of detecting crop disease before visible symptoms appear. His team said it identified spectral differences several days to approximately a week before they became visible.
The research has not yet been validated under field conditions. But it points toward a potentially valuable agricultural tool: a sensor that could identify problems early enough for farmers to intervene before damage becomes widespread.
The obstacle is economics. Hyperspectral cameras can cost tens or hundreds of thousands of dollars, require specialized expertise, and generate enormous quantities of data. Few farmers can justify that investment without a clear financial return.
Sun believes the solution may be to use hyperspectral imaging to discover which wavelengths reveal a particular disease, then build cheaper cameras that capture only those wavelengths.
Finding the wavelengths that matter

Son avancée majeure tient ailleurs : ses cellules ont enchaîné 1 000 cycles de charge complets en conservant environ 80 % de leur capacité, sous la seule pression de l'air ambiant. Notamment avec le satellite russe Kosmos 2612 qui s’est approché d’ICEYE-X36, un satellite d’observation, lors d’une manœuvre très curieuse. articles.title: Una catedral finlandesa suena cada día con el eco de estallidos de radio de hace miles de millones de años
articles.summary:
Los estallidos rápidos de radio (FRB) son uno de los fenómenos más misteriosos del Universo. Hay varias hipótesis sobre su origen, pero sigue sin estar del todo claro. Entre otros motivos, son difíciles de estudiar porque no pueden verse ni oírse. Por eso, un profesor de física del MIT se ha asociado con un compositor para convertir algunas de estas ráfagas en música. ¿Han resuelto el misterio? No, pero ahora pueden escucharse cada día en una catedral finlandesa e incluso tendrán una representación acompañada de un coro el próximo 21 de noviembre.
Sonificación. Kiyoshi Masui, del MIT, y el compositor y tecnólogo creativo Andrew Melchior han utilizado los datos de 4.539 estallidos, procedentes de 3.641 fuentes, detectados entre 2018 y 2023 con CHIME (Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment). Este es un radiotelescopio ubicado en Canadá que se concibió para mapear el hidrógeno neutro entre los corrimientos al rojo 0,8 y 2, pero que ha resultado ser un gran detector de FRB gracias a su enorme campo de visión y el caudal de datos que puede manejar.
Las distintas señales se han transformado en sonidos, de modo que los estallidos lejanos suenan como zumbidos, retumbos, chasquidos y silbidos. Además, cada estallido cae de agudos a graves, un efecto real causado por su viaje a través del gas intergaláctico. Todo esto se convierte en música, porque, al llegar las distintas frecuencias de radio en momentos ligeramente distintos, se generan armonías entre los tonos altos y bajos.…

La clave está en asegurar una conexión estable y evitar condiciones que eleven la temperatura del teléfono. La guía de YUP Charge reúne diferentes prácticas que ayudan a aprovechar mejor cada carga y a preservar el funcionamiento de la batería con el paso del tiempo.
Por qué se debe elegir un cargador original
El cargador y el cable determinan la potencia que recibe el celular. Usar accesorios certificados por el fabricante o por marcas reconocidas permite que el dispositivo regule la energía según sus especificaciones.
Muchos cargadores rápidos ofrecen entre 18W y 65W, aunque la velocidad final depende de lo que admita cada modelo de teléfono. La potencia más alta no siempre significa una carga más rápida si el dispositivo no es compatible con ese estándar.
Un adaptador de baja calidad, deteriorado o incompatible puede prolongar la carga, provocar interrupciones y elevar la temperatura. Conviene revisar el estado del cable: si presenta dobleces pronunciadas, conectores flojos o daños visibles, puede afectar la transmisión de energía.

Agentic workloads are pushing Kubernetes into territory its creators never planned for. Agents generate untrusted code on the fly, sit idle for long stretches and churn through pods at a pace that strains the orchestrator’s control plane.
Cloud providers are now rethinking how general-purpose a cluster should be. Google LLC’s answer is to stop treating every cluster as an infinitely flexible engine and tune each one into a runtime optimized for its workload, according to Jago Macleod (pictured, right), director of engineering for Kubernetes and Google Kubernetes Engine at Google Cloud.
“There isn’t enough memory. There aren’t enough machines. So we have to get more efficient. And so one of the ways that we do that is to focus the Kubernetes cluster on the workload it’s running, and optimize it for that specific workload,” Macleod said.

La sanción responde a datos que la empresa entregó al organismo durante una revisión del mercado de mensajes de texto para empresas.
Ofcom emitió su decisión el 9 de noviembre y la publicó el 12 de noviembre. Concluyó que Meta incumplió cinco veces su obligación de responder con precisión: dio datos incorrectos a cinco preguntas, incluidas en dos requerimientos formales de información.
WhatsApp Business es la versión de la aplicación de mensajería pensada para empresas, que la usan para hablar con sus clientes. Según Ofcom, los requerimientos pidieron una serie de datos sobre ese servicio, entre ellos los volúmenes de mensajes y los ingresos, y se enviaron entre julio de 2024 y agosto de 2025.
Un descuento del 25% por admitir la falta
La multa incluye una rebaja del 25% porque Meta reconoció su responsabilidad y completó el proceso de acuerdo con el regulador. Ofcom abrió la investigación el 23 de enero. Los requerimientos que originaron el caso son del 31 de julio de 2024 y del 19 de junio de 2025.
El regulador calificó las infracciones de graves. Explicó que sus facultades para pedir datos son esenciales para cumplir sus funciones y que las fallas, repetidas en varias solicitudes, ponen en riesgo la integridad del sistema y los intereses de los consumidores.

AMD Patches Radeon SSD Write Bug in Adrenalin 26.11.1 Optional Driver
AMD's Adrenalin 26.11.1 optional driver is now available with the promised fix for the Radeon bug that kept system drives writing in the background. According to the release notes, the update addresses excessive writes to the system drive while the PC is idle on Radeon RX 7000 series cards and newer. It also fixes a related case where excessive writes could show up while moving or resizing application windows.
AMD confirmed the problem earlier this week, tracing it to the External Events Client Module (atieclxx.exe) in the 26.10.1 and 26.10.2 drivers. User reports put the write rate anywhere from 0.3 MB/s to 5 MB/s, which works out to roughly 26 GB to 432 GB a day on a machine that's doing nothing. Until now, affected users had to disable the External Events Utility, turn off Resizable BAR, or use a community-made open-source tool that blocks the writes. articles.title: Critical Apache HTTP/2 Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code Remotely
articles.summary:
A critical flaw in Apache HTTP Server's HTTP/2 module, mod_http2, can let a remote attacker run code on the server. Tracked as CVE-2026-119618, it affects versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 and is fixed in version 2.4.71, released yesterday.
Only servers with HTTP/2 enabled are affected, according to Red Hat, which ships the server as part of Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
An attacker who can reach the server needs no authentication to exploit the flaw and could take full control of the server process, the Linux vendor says. It rates the flaw 9.8 out of 10 on the CVSS scale.
The vendor's assessment, published yesterday, also says "public research has demonstrated a reliable exploit" against a server in its default configuration with mod_http2 enabled. It does not name or link that research. Security company Wiz said later that day that no exploit was available and that no exploitation in the wild had been reported.
HTTP/2 runs only where the Protocols directive turns it on, as the module documentation explains. The directive uses h2 for HTTP/2 over TLS and h2c for HTTP/2 over plain TCP. It can be set for the whole server or for a single virtual host, so admins should check the server-wide setting and every virtual host.
Standalone builds of the module, released on GitHub as mod_h2, are affected from version 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
Admins who run the Apache HTTP Server project's own releases should move to version 2.4.71, the fixed release named in its security advisory. That release als…

articles.summary:
Starting Tuesday, an attacker used stolen credentials for 4,837 GitHub accounts to plant a secret stealer in repositories those accounts could write to, according to Aikido Security, a security software company.
The stealer is built to take the secrets and cloud credentials that a repository's CI workflows can reach. It ran in at least 1,806 repositories, where the attacker has likely collected those credentials, the company says.
Each attack started with a pull request titled docs: dependency audit notes, opened from a branch named wfx-docs to test whether the account could write to the repository. These test pull requests were opened in 61,764 repositories, and the stealer followed in some of them.
In a separate analysis, researchers at SafeDep, which sells software supply chain security tools, counted 8,093 repositories that received malicious commits between 12:46 UTC on Tuesday and 04:36 UTC today. That count covers every repository that received malicious commits, not only those where the stealer ran. Their search covered only the default branches of public repositories, so the true total is higher, the researchers say.
In 7,309 of those repositories, the stealer was added to an existing workflow. In 771, it came as an npm postinstall hook, which also runs on a developer's machine during npm install.

articles.title: Node.js Fixes 16 Flaws, Including HTTP/2 Bugs That Crash Servers and Leak Other Connections' Data
articles.summary:
A flaw fixed in Node.js this week lets unauthenticated clients crash servers that use the runtime's built-in HTTP/2 support on the 24.x and 26.x release lines. A second HTTP/2 flaw can cause a server to send a client pieces of its memory, including responses intended for other connections.
Fixed versions were released for all three supported lines: 22.23.5, 24.22.3, and 26.13.1.
The crash flaw, CVE-2026-123863, needs only a default HTTP/2 server that replies before the request body has fully arrived. The Node.js project calls that behavior typical. The crash works over both TLS and cleartext connections.
The memory flaw, CVE-2026-123866, affects all three lines. From 24.22.0 and 26.9.0 onward, a client alone can trigger it. On 22.x and older 24.x and 26.x builds, it can still be triggered when the server itself closes a stream partway through a response, for example after an idle timeout.
A separate flaw in Node.js HTTPS servers, CVE-2026-123864, can allow an unauthenticated client to read memory from other connections, "including TLS private keys and other users' requests," the project says. It affects all three supported lines.
The flaw needs a handler that calls res.flushHeaders() before the request body has fully arrived and later calls res.end() with data. Reading the leaked memory also needs a route that sends back or stores a request body. Plain HTTP servers built with node:http are not affected.

articles.title: Critical Pre-Auth MongoDB Flaw (CVE-2026-118383) Can Crash Lagging Servers on Failover
articles.summary:
A critical flaw in MongoDB Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to send two requests that trigger a crash on the database server. The crash occurs only if that server is later chosen to take over as the main server while it still lacks some recent changes.
MongoDB, the company that makes the database, released fixed versions earlier this week.
The affected servers are members of a replica set, a group of MongoDB servers that keep copies of the same data. One member, the primary, serves as the main server and handles all new writes, while the others replicate them. If the primary becomes unavailable, the other members hold an election to pick a new primary.
Researchers at Datadog Security Labs reproduced the crash in a lab and published their findings yesterday. On vulnerable versions, turning on authentication does not stop the two requests. An attacker cannot make the targeted member fall behind or win an election, or see when either happens, the researchers said.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-118383, is a use-after-free: the server ends up using memory it has already freed. MongoDB rated it 9.5 out of 10 on the CVSS 4.0 severity scale. The company said it found the flaw itself and was "not aware of any attempts to take advantage of this vulnerability."
Affected members include the shard and config server members of sharded clusters. A standalone mongod, a single server outside any replica set, is not affected.

Cet incroyable câble Internet installé en 1988 au fond de l'Atlantique est repêché, pour une raison surprenante !
Posé en 1988, le TAT-8 fut la toute première liaison transocéanique en fibre optique. Abandonné depuis 2002, ce pionnier des télécoms a été hissé hors de l'eau au large du Portugal. Retour sur l'histoire d'un câble qui a contribué à allumer le Web, et sur l'opération hors norme qui le ramène à la surface.
Sous nos écrans, plus de 99 % du trafic mondial de données circule dans des câbles posés au fond des océans. La plupart des internautes ignorent leur existence jusqu'au jour où l'un d'eux se rompt. L'un de ces fils, longtemps oublié dans l'Atlantique, occupe pourtant une place à part dans l'histoire des réseaux.
Un faisceau de lumière sous l'Atlantique
L'histoire commence le 14 décembre 1988. Ce jour-là, AT&T, British Telecom et France Télécom mettent en service le TAT-8, premier câble transocéanique à abandonner le cuivre coaxial au profit de la fibre optique. La technologie convertit les données en impulsions lumineuses, ce qui autorise des débits bien supérieurs, des distances plus longues et moins d'interférences. Depuis New York, l'écrivain Isaac Asimov salue par visioconférence un voyage inaugural à travers la mer sur un faisceau de lumière.
Les performances semblent dérisoires aujourd'hui, mais elles étaient révolutionnaires. Chaque paire de fibres transportait 280 Mbit/s, soit environ 40 000 conversations téléphoniques simultanées. Le câble s'appuyait sur…

Stop the pigeon

It looks like UK homeowners and renters with plug-in solar panels have a new and terrifying enemy: pigeons.
The benefits of plug-in solar are well known: while they won't wipe out your energy bills altogether they'll pay for themselves by lowering your electricity usage from the grid. But nobody told us about the pigeon poop.
The Cooldown has spotted a fascinating thread on Reddit's SolarUK subreddit where a would-be buyer asked for words of wisdom from more experienced solar users: what things should they look for?
And in among very practical suggestions, one issue kept swooping in: birds, specifically pigeons.
Why pigeons could be a problem for your plug-in panels
If like me you live near a pigeon owner, or if you've been in the city center lately, you'll be vividly aware that pigeons poop.
A lot.
That poop is no ordinary poop. Pigeon droppings are a health hazard, and contain uric acid. That's what strips the paint from your car if you don't wash it off quickly enough, and it's a potential headache for UK solar panel owners.

articles.title: Un nouveau rival du DLSS promet une meilleure génération d'images sur presque toutes les cartes graphiques
articles.summary:
Apex Compute dévoile Apex Neural Rendering, une suite de rendu par IA censée fonctionner sur les cartes NVIDIA, AMD et Intel, y compris anciennes. Seule la génération d’images est disponible, en bêta.
Le DLSS n’a jamais été disponible que sur GeForce RTX, et sa génération d’images reste réservée à des cartes récentes. Apex Neural Rendering (ANR) vise justement l’inverse : une technologie de génération d'images qui tourne partout, y compris sur le Steam Deck.
Une compatibilité large, des GTX 16 aux Arc
ANR regroupe trois briques : la génération d’images, l’upscaling (super-résolution) et la reconstruction de rayons. Seule la première est pour l’instant accessible en bêta, les deux autres devant suivre plus tard.
Le périmètre matériel est large : GeForce GTX 16 et RTX 20 ou plus récentes, Radeon RX 5000 ou plus récentes, Intel Arc séries A et B, plus le Steam Deck. Côté logiciel, la bêta fonctionne sous Windows 10 et 11, Linux et SteamOS via Proton. Autrement dit, des GPU que NVIDIA laisse de côté pour ses propres outils peuvent ici prétendre à la génération d’images.
Sur une GeForce RTX 5090 en 4K, Apex Compute annonce 1,01 ms pour générer une image en mode 2x, contre 1,26 ms pour la génération d’images du DLSS. En 4x, l’écart est de 0,61 ms contre 0,82 ms. L’empreinte mémoire serait de 214 Mo, contre 562 Mo pour le DLSS.
Ces chiffres touchent un point sensible de la technique : la latence ajoutée. Mais il s’agit de benchmarks publiés par l’éditeur lui-même, et un calcul d’ima…

articles.title: PTC Patches Critical Windchill and FlexPLM Flaw That Could Enable Remote Code Execution
articles.summary:
PTC has released patches for a new critical vulnerability impacting Windchill and FlexPLM software that, if successfully exploited, could result in remote code execution.
The security flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-126325, carries a CVSS v4 score of 9.2 out of a maximum of 10.0.
It has been described as a case of improper input validation and deserialization of untrusted data that could result in remote code execution via crafted requests.
"A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability has been reported in PTC Windchill and PTC FlexPLM," according to a description of the flaw on CVE.org. "The vulnerability may be exploited through the deserialization of untrusted data."
The CVE record lists the following versions as affected -
- PTC Windchill: 11.0 M030, 11.1 M020, 11.2.1.0, 12.0.2.0, 12.1.2.0, 13.0.2.0, 13.1.0.0, 13.1.1.0, 13.1.2.0, 13.1.3.0, 13.1.4.0
- PTC FlexPLM: 11.0 M030, 11.1 M020, 11.2.1.0, 12.0.2.0, 12.1.2.0, 13.0.2.0, 13.1.0.0, 13.1.1.0, 13.1.2.0, 13.1.3.0
"If your Windchill or FlexPLM environment is hosted by PTC, the patches have been applied on their behalf. No action is required on your part," PTC said in a statement posted on its website.
"If your Windchill or FlexPLM environment is not hosted by PTC, we urge you to apply the patch as soon as possible to help protect your systems."

Depuis fin 2024, une directive européenne impose l'USB-C à tous les smartphones neufs, mettant fin à la jungle des connecteurs propriétaires. articles.title: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
articles.summary:
Since mid-August 2026, a phishing operation has been stealing live Google sessions from corporate users. Every check defenders normally lean on to judge a link came back clean, and the operator designed it that way on purpose.
The Threat Research team at Material Security spotted the campaign and has since taken down hundreds of attacker domains in an effort the team calls Operation CloudFire. Here’s what the researchers found.
The lure: Google Calendar invites
The messages show up as Google Calendar invites. Some arrive by BCC, and many come from an organization the recipient has already traded email with. The pretexts are deliberately boring: voicemail notifications, RFP and RFI requests, court summonses, and missed payment notices. Nothing about them stands out in a busy inbox.
Most of the links point to Google itself. The usual pattern runs through Google’s own /url redirector, with the real destination tucked into a query parameter. Other waves used share.google and Drive file links the same way, and one variant leaned on Intuit transaction notification links. Whenever a message gets scored, the domain, certificate, and reputation on display are all legitimate.
The capture: a reverse proxy in front of Google sign-in
Once a victim clicks through, the attacker runs a live reverse proxy in front of the real Google sign-in page. The victim types a password, gets a genuine prompt, and approves it while the operator watches in real time. The server passes each second factor al…

articles.title: Qué hacer antes de usar una freidora de aire por primera vez para evitar accidentes al cocinar
articles.summary:
Una freidora de aire permite preparar alimentos mediante la circulación de aire caliente dentro de una cesta cerrada. Antes del primer uso, conviene limpiar sus piezas, elegir una ubicación adecuada y realizar un ciclo de precalentamiento para retirar posibles olores propios de fabricación y evitar problemas durante la cocción.
Las pautas de uso indicadas por fabricantes como Moulinex apuntan a una preparación simple: poner los alimentos en el electrodoméstico, definir el programa o ajustar tiempo y temperatura, y poner en marcha el aparato.
En este sentido, se explica todo lo que se debe saber para cocinar por primera vez con una freidora de aire, sumado a cómo evitar accidentes durante su uso.
Por qué hay que leer el manual del fabricante antes de encender la freidora de aire
El primer paso consiste en revisar las instrucciones específicas del modelo y conservar el manual en un lugar accesible. Aunque el funcionamiento general de las freidoras de aire es similar, cada aparato puede contar con programas, piezas desmontables, límites de carga y sugerencias de limpieza propios.
Además, es importante identificar los componentes de la cesta, la rejilla y, si corresponde, la parte frontal desmontable. Las almohadillas de silicona que algunos modelos incluyen en la rejilla no deben retirarse, porque forman parte del diseño del accesorio y ayudan a mantenerlo en su posición.

articles.title: New N-central Exploits Work Against Patched Servers, Enable Root RCE and Windows SYSTEM Access
articles.summary:
N-able on Thursday said it's investigating a new public disclosure containing claims of additional vulnerabilities in on-premise versions of N-central running version 2026.4.1 HF2.
"Based on our initial review, the server issue described depends on a non-default configuration in which the Legacy API is turned on and exposed to the public internet," N-able said in a new advisory. "Legacy API is turned off by default in the product and is not recommended."
The company is urging customers to disable Legacy API immediately, if not already. It also noted that hosted environments are not affected by this issue.
The incident impacts the following services -
- N-central On-premise (Americas)
- N-central On-premise (APAC)
- N-central On-premise (Europe)
The development comes days after N-able released 2026.4.1.26 to address a number of security flaws disclosed by independent security researcher Sean Bales earlier this week. The vulnerabilities are collectively tracked under the name Able2Shell.
The new shortcoming, also revealed by Bales, have been codenamed 4EverAble2Shell and Agent2Shell, adding the proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits successfully work against N-central 2026.4 Hotfix 2 (build 2026.4.1.26), the update N-able released on November 10, 2026, to resolve Able2Shell.
According to the researcher, 4EverAble2Shell enables unauthenticated remote code execution with root privileges on N-central servers. Agent2Shell, on the other hand, leverages more than 10 zero-day vulnerabilities…

articles.title: Google Cloud Warns Three AMD Turin CPU Flaws Could Leak Data Across Processes in VMs
articles.summary:
Google Cloud VMs on AMD Turin chips need a guest OS patch and a stop-and-start to protect against three CPU side-channel flaws, Google said this week.
The company has already applied mitigations against attacks between VMs, and between VMs and the host. Inside a VM, the flaws may let an attacker with code on the same processor core infer data from other processes or the kernel.
The affected machine series are C4D, N4D, H4D, Z4D,, and G4, including bare-metal instances of C4D and Z4D. Turin is the code name for fifth-generation AMD EPYC processors.

articles.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Flaw Lets Attackers Read and Overwrite All Private Container Images in a Registry
articles.summary:
A critical flaw in Red Hat Quay allows an attacker who can access a Quay registry to read and overwrite private container images in every repository.
Quay enables anonymous access by default, and while it is enabled, the attacker needs no account. When it is off, anyone with a valid account can still exploit the flaw, Red Hat said yesterday. The company has released fixed builds for eight Quay 3 branches.
The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-123710 (CVSS score: 9.8).
Quay uses keys it trusts to sign the access tokens that allow image pushes and pulls. The flaw lets an attacker add their own key to the keys Quay trusts, with no expiry date. Quay then accepts tokens signed with that key for any repository.
With those tokens, an attacker can retrieve private images and any secrets or credentials stored within them. The attacker can also push or overwrite images, and the change propagates to every system that later pulls those images.
The planted key survives restarts until someone removes it. It can also be used to delete the keys that running Quay instances use, so normal pushes and pulls start failing with authentication errors.
Quay's key server checks that a request to replace a key carries a token signed by a trusted key, with the expected audience and issuer. It does not check whether the token was issued for key rotation. An anonymous token from Quay's /v2/auth endpoint passes: Quay signs it with a trusted key, and the caller chooses its audience.

Barr aclaró que no hace una predicción: sus palabras sugieren prepararse para tensiones sociales, no anticiparlas. El gobernador reconoció que hasta ahora hubo “relativamente poco desplazamiento” de trabajadores por la IA y que hay datos de que la tecnología mejora la productividad de algunos empleados.
También hay señales en sentido contrario. “Ya vemos indicios de que la IA puede sustituir mano de obra en algunos sectores, en especial a los trabajadores más jóvenes y con menos experiencia”, afirmó. Las tareas fáciles de automatizar, con reglas claras y resultados predecibles, podrían sufrir una sustitución rápida. En cambio, las que exigen criterio, coordinación, relaciones personales o creatividad tendrían más probabilidades de que la IA complemente al trabajador en lugar de reemplazarlo.
El trabajo recibe una parte cada vez menor del ingreso
Barr citó un dato central: la participación del trabajo en el ingreso nacional cayó a un mínimo histórico de 52,8% en el segundo trimestre de 2026. Entre el fin de la Segunda Guerra Mundial y 2001 se había mantenido entre el 60% y el 65%.

articles.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
articles.summary:
Public exploit code released earlier this week claims that a local Windows user can gain SYSTEM privileges through the Common Log File System driver.
The proof of concept, called SignDrop, targets a log-authentication feature added to the driver last year. It abuses how clfs.sys creates companion files when a privileged process opens a prepared log, using path redirection to take control of the operation. Microsoft has not confirmed the claimed flaw, assigned a CVE, or released a fix.
The researcher behind the exploit, who publishes under the name MSNightmare, released the code and a detailed writeup on GitHub on Tuesday, the same day the company published its November security updates.
CLFS is a logging subsystem built into Windows. Its driver has been a frequent target for privilege escalation: 10 CLFS flaws appear in CISA's catalog of vulnerabilities known to have been exploited in attacks, including one used in ransomware campaigns in April 2025.
To reduce that exposure, Microsoft added an authentication check to CLFS log files in updates for Windows 11 25H2, 26H1, and Windows Server 2025 shipped in October 2025. The check attaches a hash-based message authentication code, built from log data and a key unique to each machine.
The driver then parses only log files it wrote. A companion .cnpf file stores recovery data beside each log and is created with the same security attributes as the original, according to the company's logfile authentication page.

Synchron, la empresa de Brooklyn que compite con Neuralink, de Elon Musk, frenó los ensayos clínicos de la segunda generación de su implante cerebral porque el dispositivo no funcionó como esperaba en los primeros voluntarios. Lo informó la revista Wired, que también supo de despidos y de un cambio de sede.
La compañía confirmó la pausa en una declaración a Wired. Dijo que la decidió ella misma, tras detectar un problema de rendimiento en el cable que lleva las señales desde el implante hasta la electrónica implantada. Aseguró que la falla no está en el implante y que no se identificaron problemas de seguridad.
Synchron precisó que se trató de una decisión propia y no de una orden de la FDA, la agencia que aprueba medicamentos y dispositivos médicos en Estados Unidos. La empresa dijo además que pasó a fabricar y diseñar ese cable en sus propias instalaciones.
Un implante que no requiere cirugía cerebral
El dispositivo se llama Stentrode. Es un tubo de malla similar a un stent, el pequeño resorte que abre arterias, que entra por la vena yugular, en la base del cuello, y se guía con un catéter hasta apoyarlo sobre la zona del cerebro que controla el movimiento. Por eso la empresa lo presenta como menos invasivo.

Le ministère des Armées a officialisé ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026 la création de l'International Center for Artificial Intelligence in Defence (ICAID), un centre international pour l'intelligence artificielle de défense qui sera implanté à Rennes. Il devra surtout développer l'expertise et les méthodes pour concevoir, acquérir, déployer et évaluer des services d'IA dans la défense. Your SIEM or EDR may catch the activity. But without knowing who owns that identity, what permissions it has, and which systems it can reach, your SOC is missing a critical part of the story.
